# Theme phase 2: light mode on the public pages

Written 2026-11-08. Phase 1 (branch `feat/theme-setting`) gave the signed-in pages a Light / Dark / System setting.
Sachin's call on 2026-11-08: phase 1 is the pages behind the login; the public pages are phase 2, on their own branch
and merge.

## Where phase 1 left it

- The choice lives in `localStorage['aiastra.theme']` (`system` default, `light`, `dark`), set in Profile › Locale
  and appearance (`src/components/ThemeSwitch.tsx`). It survives sign-out (`KEPT_LOCAL_STORAGE_KEYS`).
- `src/lib/theme.ts` `THEMED_PREFIXES` = `/dashboard`, `/profile`, `/welcome`. Only those paths get the viewer's
  theme; every other path gets `dark` on `<html>`. The same list is a regex in the inline script in `index.html`
  (a unit test keeps the two in step). `ThemeScope` (inside the router) re-applies on every route change.
- Light mode is CSS: `src/index.css` (sky, glass, scrim, prose) plus `src/theme-light.css`, generated by
  `node scripts/gen-light-theme.mjs` from the colour classes in `src/`. Its rules already cover the classes the public
  pages use, so most of phase 2 is turning the scope on and fixing what the screenshots show.

## Phase 2 scope

1. Pages: landing (`/`, the parchment scrolls over the photo scenes), sign-in, sign-up and sign-up details, pricing,
   terms, privacy, refunds, the public 404, and any public assistant page added by then.
2. Remove the path gate: `THEMED_PREFIXES` and the `index.html` regex go (every page follows the choice), or widen
   them page by page.
3. A visible switch for signed-out visitors (header or footer of `PublicFrame`), since Profile is not reachable.
4. The photo scenes (`CosmicSky`): `html.light .sky-scrim` washes them pale already; decide with Sachin whether light
   mode keeps night photos washed out or gets daytime scenes. The parchment scrolls look the same in both themes.
5. Turnstile: `src/Auth/TurnstileField.tsx` passes `theme: 'dark'`; switch it to the applied theme.
6. The prerendered public HTML (`scripts/prerender`) must keep the inline theme script before the first paint.
7. Screenshots: extend `e2e/theme.spec.ts` (public pages expected in the chosen theme, not dark), phone and desktop,
   under `docs/screenshots/theme/`, and list them in `AIAstra_Server/QA-LIST.MD`.
